Senses.Explanation: The completion of a buddha's career in four graphs — and in the hall's hands a movable event: the staff is lifted and every saint and ordinary being attains it on the tip, the whisk strikes the chair and all attain it right here, no time but this. The relocation: Dahui Zonggao strikes the seat once with the whisk — the dust-grain buddhas, the six paths and four births, the grass and the trees, sentient and insentient, all attain it right here, nothing outside this moment; Yunwai Xingze presents the staff and shows the assembly that through the lands of the ten directions and three times, saint and ordinary alike, all together attain it and turn the great wheel on the mountain monk's staff-tip; Hanyue Fazang shouts that one word of this can make the mountains, rivers, and earth, the grass, trees, wind, and cloud, the sentient and insentient, turn the great wheel and attain it at once — want to understand? Enter here. The checks on the completion: Zhongfeng Mingben rules the self-aspect — even seated on the jeweled lotus attaining it, entering a dust-mote to turn the great wheel, that too is the self-aspect; Muchen Daomin raises the dragon girl speeding to the southern spotless world and attaining it in one finger-snap, then asks whether that is the same or different from the gate's standing-on-the-spot buddhahood — say same and the eyes are not yet open, say different and one wanders kalpas with no term; Dahui's exposition walks Maitreya's full descent — birth, seven steps, the palace, leaving home, hardship, the seat, subduing the demons, attaining it, the wheel, nirvana; Yongming Yanshou quotes the teaching that awakening is signless, so attaining it equals awakening, one sign and no sign — and no sentient being lacks the original awakening, identical in body with the buddha; Yulin Tongxiu at the incense burns the petal received at Vulture Peak, praying the Buddha-hearted Son of Heaven to attain it.
